# R2.1 final integration, UI freeze and device acceptance

## Authorized scope and source

The user authorized the final Quiet Edge R2.1 integration into the actual current
main on 2026-10-31, followed by a freeze of this phase's functional visual work.
This supersedes the earlier mainline-migration exclusion of PR #24. The existing
source-admission protocol and every product safety boundary continue unchanged.

- Main integration base: `749f3ae81b8a75a9462506bfeb3d3cf2796ed154`.
- Independently delivered implementation: `1e834902794048942f112aee98bc5fcec5566930`.
- Original PR #24 handoff: `c63309c3850fd16969dc0117d47da5bc854e9cc8`.
- Original formal product ancestor: `253ac8db92bfba9083d485b71b84c594223da217`.

The final source checkpoint and its direct admission-only child are identified
by `engineering/mainline/source-admission.json`. The formal integration PR records
actual PR/main CI, original artifact IDs, source/checkout identities and hashes.
Use those completed results and the App's `build-info.json`; this source document
does not pre-approve a pending run or infer a physical result from compilation.

The integration selects the four R2.1 UI implementation files, two synthetic
native-helper files, six UI test files, six fixed synthetic PNGs with their
manifest/README, and the R2.1 capture script. The existing Native workflow gains
the same seven-line capture step; the mainline triggers, five check identities,
source gate and all existing execution steps remain intact. The R2.1 source and
handoff history are preserved as the initial integration commit's second parent, while
their archived PNG/MOV evidence is not duplicated into the current main tree.

No old R2 baseline replaces main. App composition and instance ownership, Core,
Capture, adapters, Feedback, services, database, Package, resources, packaging,
the 34 approved website/configuration objects, and all accepted historical
evidence remain at their main objects. Only the explicitly reviewed increment
is admitted. The complete object map is in this integration's provenance record.

## Product decisions that are now fixed

R2.1 retains R2 placement, vertical pagination, original image Fit, original
input islands and strict upload-start ownership. Three free-edge contours and
the neutral number surface meet a fixed seam plane. Decorative padding and
shadows do not enlarge mouse-receiving regions; press feedback is stationary.
The magnetic trajectory retains its original owner/lifetime and clips the full
decorated surface. No new user preference or appearance mode is introduced.

Continuous preview uses 450 ms cold and 90 ms warm dwell, a frozen current-page
canvas, atomic image/UUID/rank presentation, session/request/revision fences,
one active decode and one replaceable pending request. New screenshots outside
the visible page preserve a valid preview; actual page/identity/geometry changes
and foreground-application changes revoke it. The original number hit frame is
preserved even where it is smaller than the design document's assumed minimum.

After this integration's successful standard merge, this phase's functional UI
is frozen. Do not add another layout, microimage style or long-lived design
candidate. Concentrate work on real usability, reliability and first-release
readiness. A blocking defect demonstrated by final acceptance may receive a
minimal reviewed fix on a short-lived PR from actual main, with targeted
reverification and the existing full formal gates. New explicit user direction
can supersede the freeze; an agent must not infer that authorization from a
minor stylistic difference or an old design exploration.

## Exact evidence boundaries

The original PR #24 Native run `41183924489` and Feedback run `41183924475`
tested implementation `1e834902...` on checkout `e3dee8ae...`. Their execution
jobs passed, but both overall workflows failed because the old exact formal
source gate was deliberately not repinned. These results are prior increment
evidence, not a fully admitted combined build and not the final main runs.
The first R2.1 native failure and its reviewed correction remain in their
original history. Do not conceal them or bypass the new mainline gate.

Original R2.1 WindowServer PNGs and sampled motion cover synthetic owned native
windows at 1x. They support the documented appearance and sampled lifecycle
observations. Static preview does not prove a real-pointer A-to-B-to-A sequence;
variable-cadence motion does not prove every frame or a latency benchmark.
Final combined CI, native image review and package checks are recorded against
their actual new source/checkout. Physical input, actual 2x/mixed monitors and
real ordinary-App upload require their own evidence.

Formal integration added a native CALayer regression for visual refresh during
an already committed composite exit. Provisional source `0134dddb...` reproduced
the defect on ARM: assigning the moving layer's frame restored its effective
position and exposed content again, even though the transform and named
animation remained. The minimal repair assigns untransformed bounds/base position
instead, preserving the existing exit transform and animation. The regression
checks both sides, narrow/wide slices, every moving surface, the fixed mask and
contact plane, source dimensions and animation values/duration. Its initial
test-only overload compilation error at `fd2a0046...` and the subsequent actual
native failure remain separately recorded in the integration provenance. Final
corrected-source CI must pass; these earlier failures are not admission results.

The old U1 approximately 1.876638-second observation is internal-configuration
swallow start followed by later independent background success. It retains its
prebound, focused, existing-chat scope. It is not default production acceptance
or a 1.88-second completed upload. The prior selection-preservation failure is
still unresolved until the exact final App proves the required behavior.

## Production and data boundaries

Ordinary production input/start/completion, built-in screenshot upload,
safe-retry and Web continuation remain closed. Existing restricted-candidate
scope is unchanged. Keep old UNKNOWN operations, original screenshots, media,
history, databases and feedback identities. Do not delete, reset, unlock or
replay them to make acceptance pass. Do not expand a default production profile
to obtain a test result. No public release or founder Beta trial is requested.

Source admission records real non-author engineering review; it does not prove
a separate GitHub human APPROVED identity. Main protection proceeds separately
only with actual Administration permission, a supported configuration/readback
surface and an eligible non-author reviewer. Apply the approved request only
when it will not lock the repository. Otherwise record the exact missing
capability and continue unrelated integration. Never bypass a remote rule.

## Minimal final Codex device acceptance

Use the completed final main build and the matching architecture's original CI
ZIP. Record main/source/checkout/tree, run/artifact IDs, ZIP/binary hashes, macOS,
architecture and signing status. Read existing instances, data roots and queued
Feedback obligations before using a new isolated test operation. Do not overwrite
another developer's tree or use the helper/demo as the ordinary product App.

1. **Startup, ownership and recovery.** Start the ordinary unified App; verify
   screenshot/history/settings/Feedback belong to the same package/process.
   Check second-instance rejection, normal quit/restart and isolated controlled
   abnormal recovery. Preserve stores and old operations; do not delete locks.
2. **R2.1 microimages and interaction.** Verify left/right fixed contact planes,
   source orientation/proportion, alpha display, neutral numbers and stationary
   press. Check retained R2 positions/configuration, paging, protected refill,
   new arrivals outside the current page, and continuous A-to-B-to-A pointer
   preview with cold/warm dwell and no stale image/identity or canvas movement.
   Check original-image Fit/100%/200%, missing/replaced originals and magnetic
   arrival/strict-start exit. Preserve the existing click targets and draft focus.
3. **System capture and cancellation.** On final source check region, window,
   full screen and cancel, original-byte import/deduplication, normal screenshot
   exclusion and source/target binding. A foreign-overlap safety veto remains
   NOT_RUN for the affected functional case, not a fabricated capture PASS.
4. **Actual one-click attachment and repeat use.** Along the existing approved
   isolated path, use new screenshots/operations for existing chat and Home/local,
   focused/unfocused editor, natural cold first click without a pre-existing ACK,
   and consecutive uploads. Record unique input, true uploadStarted, swallow
   start, later independent completion and restart state separately. Safe zero-
   input refusal is a safety result, not successful one-click usability.
5. **Preservation and the known selection failure.** Preserve body, stable old
   attachments and noncollapsed selection. Locate first blur/collapse and compare
   the native attachment path; do not force focus, restore a stale Range or edit
   body text to manufacture success. Keep UNKNOWN and original media unchanged.
6. **Native Feedback to cloud.** First establish independent access to the same
   deployment's D1 and correct private Issues repository, plus exact cleanup.
   Then use one new synthetic native feedback and correlate original UUID/body,
   durable receipt and one private Issue; check real IME, draft/restart, offline
   recovery/idempotency, frozen diagnostics, deletion and screenshot isolation.
   Follow `engineering/evidence/2026-10-29-feedback-cloud/CODEX_REAL_MAC_E2E.md`;
   old cloud script or offline demo success does not replace this native path.
7. **Physical environment and permissions.** Check actual multi-monitor
   disconnect/reconnect, negative coordinates, 2x/mixed Retina, Spaces/full screen,
   VoiceOver spoken output and physical mouse/keyboard. If one case requires a
   person or a new OS permission, record its precise requirement and continue
   the other cases. Do not automate consent or claim physical evidence from
   model geometry, synthetic callbacks or CI screenshots.

Return MAC_PASS/CLOUD_PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN/BLOCKED per case, exact source and redacted
evidence, residual obligations and minimal corrective work. Inherit already
proved scope without restarting research. No unattended executor is implied by
this checklist. Production activation requires independently approved evidence
for the exact final App and the specific capability being admitted.

在 Mac 回执 [6546112515](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/Virtual-AI-Workspace-Layer/pull/16#issuecomment-6546112515)、[6546368431](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/Virtual-AI-Workspace-Layer/pull/16#issuecomment-6546368431) 之后，复核 PR #16 远程 HEAD 仍为 `5593e02eb81b1fc8fda3a12dc945d0280cf67d60`，Draft/open；Pro 为唯一远程源码/测试 writer。此评论只负责工程归因与派工，不争用代码。

**事实与严禁误判**
- 普通聊天中，真实 CG 鼠标事件已成功将 workspace 从隐藏变为显示；这是真实有限正例，不是完整阅读往返。
- 原生 Project 菜单点击「项目主页」实际进入 `/g/g-p-<32hex>/project`，有唯一原生主区/选中 tab 与 panel 双向引用、当前 Project ID 一致的两个成员 `SECTION→OL→LI→A`。**这是可核对的关系结构，不是私人 scope 授权或现成的产品归属完成。**
- Project 页面 `frame=0, return=0`，原生主区、composer、member list 仍存在。当前私有 `refusal` / `presentation` 未取得；公开 `startup=surface-failed` 是历史标记，`surfaceStop=other` 不定位根因。不能把它归为 srcdoc/浏览器代理干扰、选择器错误、paint/geometry 或竞态中的任一种。
- Mac 已用完累计 **36/36** 固定 DOM 检查；不要让 Codex 越权追加、更换目标重置预算、重复安装、claim 浏览器或发送/读取正文。真实原生动作剩余额度也不构成读取新 DOM 的授权。

**要求 Pro 立即开始实质修复，而非追加研究报告**
1. 从当前正式源码的 **Project 专属入口链**排查：`src/host/chatgpt-observed-profile.mjs` 的 `projectListBoundary`、`nativeProjectLayout` / `waitForNativeLayout`；`src/host/chatgpt-adapter.mjs` 的 `projectSurface()`、`inspect()`（明确区分 `unsafe-native-project-layout` 和 `unsafe-native-geometry`）；`src/host/native-project-surface.mjs` 的唯一主区、tab/tabpanel、composer-title、viewport/overflow、ancestor、paint、return-slot 检查；然后是 `flow-mount-surface.mjs` 的入场与初始授权生命周期。
2. 利用 Mac 已提供的**无正文** `project-live-minimal.json`、probe18–20 和原始证据清单，构造匿名严格 fixture（当前两成员、正确 Project 路由、页头/输入/tabpanel 几何）。先完整复现「原生页存在但 iframe/return 均 0」或明确记录哪个字段尚不足以唯一确定拒绝路径。不得通过改宽松 selector、提高 paint 上限、关闭安全校验或把 route 当 scope/grant 来制造通过。
3. 若已复现确定性缺陷，沿原唯一分支直接提交限定源码修复、修前 RED/修后 GREEN、原生输入/撤权/Worker/恢复的关联连续旅程、独审与同 SHA GitHub CI；向 Codex 交接一次新候选的**仅 Project 页面**短路径复验，无关已通过项目复用证据。
4. 若现有现场证据不足以区分失败阶段，**不要猜修**；明确输出一个最小、无正文、一次性可验证的私有拒绝码/阶段字段及安全来源，等待下次获准的集中 Mac 复验；不得用尽额外检查额度去广泛扫描。Codex 不修改 `src/tests`，Pro 仍唯一 writer。

### Project 拒绝阶段未记录：已有代码中的具体接线差额（非现场根因裁定）

只读核对冻结 HEAD `5593e02e`：`src/host/native-project-surface.mjs` 已在 `inspectNativeProjectSurface(..., onFailure)` 内提供有限 `stage` 失败枚举及 `projectSurfaceFailureReasons`；但 `src/host/chatgpt-adapter.mjs` 的 `projectSurface(geometry)` 调用没有传递 `onFailure`，`inspect()` 只能外部返回 `unsafe-native-project-layout` / `unsafe-native-geometry`。因此单靠现有公开回执不能区分失败来自主区 selector、viewport wrapper、geometry、return-slot 或 paint。

# Maintenance status: bounded document revalidation

## Original evidence and scope

Main `d69c829ecf2937a04cc1d7e982f367b24e52b591` (0.55.29), Maintenance run `40722115965`, attempt 1, retained seven passing native scenarios and one failure: release `trusted-confirmation-and-peers` could not load the purpose status after reload. The source counterpart passed. Artifact `12830378731` has SHA256 `d6e6ae9454b9c43cb29ad38f7bc61f5d8e19e297d318164cec8b3c83b02c9cf6`.

The original worker trace records one successful post-reload status, then two `FORBIDDEN` reads. Each failed read encountered a native `loading` / `complete` pulse while its initial document check was awaiting. The current tab and context still matched the new sender's document identity, but the command's loading listener had irrevocably cancelled the request. The original screenshot shows an unavailable permission check and the existing manual check-again action, not a granted preference.

The observer did not synthesize tab events or replace native results. The trace does not identify the exact initiator of each loading event. Same-URL History calls exist in the ordinary UI, but they were not observed directly. Relevant authentication, UI and fixture source is unchanged from 0.55.28; this is not evidence that the four 0.55.29 local-protection runtime changes introduced the failure.

## Narrow correction

- Only a STATUS read's **initial** document check may be invalidated provisionally by a status-only loading event. Its initial authentication is not used as current authority.
- Once that first check completes, the provisional window closes. The already-budgeted second full document check runs before reading permission and must prove the exact sender/document/frame/tab/window/URL/non-incognito facts and an actual `complete` tab with no pending navigation.
- Original permission and purpose-state reads follow. The third full document check still occurs before returning the result and must again prove complete status. Original current-request and purpose-result facts remain mandatory.
- Any subsequent loading event, any URL event, removal, mismatching/new document or old-document replay remains denied. Every WRITE and early OFF revocation retains its original hard cancellation and persisted/unconfirmed semantics.
- No loop, additional native read, new RPC, timeout change, authentication cache, provider activation or permission was introduced. The maximum remains three `tabs.get` and three `getContexts` calls per status request. Ordinary reads retain their original order. A late loading pulse still fails closed; no universal reload-success claim is made.

## Focused evidence and limits

The new dedicated 20-case file uses the real command, consent owner and store with isolated fake IndexedDB/native metadata boundaries. Against original code it recorded 12 passes and eight failures, including both initial-tab and initial-context loading success controls. With the correction, 19 passed and one fixture failed because it incorrectly called the intentionally unsupported `consent(false)` API. That failure is retained. Only that fixture was corrected to revoke the real synthetic control row through its original store transaction; its one-case rerun passed. No production change accompanied the fixture correction and no other cases were replayed.

Controls retain exact identity, pending-navigation rejection, subsequent-loading cancellation, real permission revocation, final-document replacement, original native-error identity, no added reads, no consent creation, ON-write rejection and immediate/sticky OFF denial. Syntax and diff checks passed. No old test suite, browser or cloud job was rerun. Native source/release success for this changed source, integration versioning and publication remain separate; the original seven-pass/one-failure run is not relabelled.
